title: Corbell presses Jacques Vallée on Lazar at his ranch

tellings.quote: things. I pushed him on it once at my ranch alone.

plain: A filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell says he once pressed Jacques Vallée, a long-time UFO researcher, about Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. Corbell tells Michels it happened in private at his own ranch: "I pushed him on it once at my ranch alone." What Vallée said back is not given here.
